scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w packages/domain && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run build -w packages/domain && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
